quests.title: A Tour of Wonders

dialogue.t: Please wait! Are you also here for the King of Invokations Grand Prix?
If you have a minute, I'd like to tell you a little about this event hosted by the Adventurers' Guild called "A Tour of Wonders."
Thank you! Then I'll go ahead and introduce the basics of this event.
Simply put, the Adventurers' Guild has placed multiple Scenic Checkpoints in various locations across Mondstadt.
All you have to do is find these Scenic Checkpoints and mark your Sightseeing Handbook with the commemorative stamps at each location.
The challenge will be considered completed once you find every Scenic Checkpoint and collect all the stamps.

dialogue.sit: Sure sounds like something the Adventurers' Guild would host.

dialogue.t: Hehe... We put a lot of thought into the placement of these Scenic Checkpoints.
However... some of them are located in remote areas, and I can't guarantee they're entirely clear of monsters.
But I'm sure that dealing with those monsters would be a walk in the park for someone as experienced as you.
And that's all from me! Here's your Sightseeing Handbook. Have fun!

quests.description: Onnea from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you…
